svg.title: Orbit: @falahsheikh's GitHub activity as ASCII art
svg.desc: Every day since sep 5, 2022 on a spiral of text characters, one turn per year, denser and brighter where there were more contributions (1,060 in total). 9 public repositories orbit as moons. Data visualization by Falah Sheikh.

g.text: wound into a spiral, one turn a year.
the center is the first day,
a pulse of light replays the
each moon is a public repository,
this year make it orbit faster.
a data visualization by falah sheikh
redrawn daily from the github api · nov 24, 2026
